name: hp_search_cross_dataset_seed52
description: Pre-experiment: random hyperparameter search following AdaTime's sweep, cross-dataset transfers, seed 52, every run starting from the supplied seed-52 source-only checkpoint.
start_model: supplied source-only checkpoint of the transfer: models/cross_dataset/<transfer>/model_last.pt

fixed.pipeline: as Stage 2: supervisor data IO and splits, separate source and target passes in train mode, epoch = source batches, target cycled

order: combination by combination: combination k for all transfers x methods, then k + 1

sampling.generator: numpy default_rng([seed, index of the method in methods]); per combination in this order: learning rate, source weight, alignment weight

alignment_weight.note: AdaTime's sweep varies mmd_wt for DSAN, but its DSAN loss reads domain_loss_wt (algorithms/algorithms.py:624; fixed at 1.59 in configs/hparams.py:60), so in AdaTime the LMMD weight is never searched. The range given for mmd_wt is applied to the weight the loss uses (our lmmd_weight = AdaTime domain_loss_wt).

reference_combinations.0: stage2: AdaTime loss weights for HAR with learning rate 3e-4, exactly the Stage-2 setting (device check against the Stage-2 runs of seed 52)
reference_combinations.1: adatime_hparams: AdaTime configs/hparams.py for HAR including its learning rate

adatime.sweep_uses_only_alg_space: trainers/sweep.py:51-56: the wandb sweep gets sweep_alg_hparams[da_method] only
adatime.unused_train_space: configs/sweep_params.py:1-10 (sweep_train_hparams: num_epochs, batch_size, learning_rate, disc_lr, weight_decay, step_size, gamma, optimizer) is defined but not used by the sweep
adatime.one_setting_for_all_scenarios: trainers/sweep.py:71-96: every sweep run trains all scenarios of the dataset with the same hyperparameters
adatime.hparams_har: configs/hparams.py:12-18 (train_params: num_epochs 40, batch_size 32, weight_decay 1e-4, step_size 50, lr_decay 0.5), 42-47 (DANN), 56-62 (DSAN), 71-76 (Deep_Coral)
adatime.losses_read: algorithms/algorithms.py:200-201 (Deep_Coral: coral_wt, src_cls_loss_wt), 359-360 (DANN: src_cls_loss_wt, domain_loss_wt), 624-625 (DSAN: domain_loss_wt, src_cls_loss_wt)
adatime.discriminator_optimizer: algorithms/algorithms.py:306-310: same learning_rate and weight_decay as the network, betas (0.5, 0.99)
adatime.few_shot: trainers/abstract_trainer.py:147-148 and dataloader/dataloader.py:106-128: 5 windows per class from the target test split, drawn with torch.randperm

deviations_from_adatime: Epochs fixed at 30 (Stage 2) instead of AdaTime's 40 (configs/hparams.py:13): the runs continue training the source-only model instead of training from scratch. AdaTime's sweep does not vary the epochs or the batch size either: sweep_train_hparams (configs/sweep_params.py:1-10) is not passed to the sweep (trainers/sweep.py:55).
Batch size fixed at 32 (Stage 2 = AdaTime HAR, configs/hparams.py:14); weight decay fixed at 1e-4 (AdaTime HAR alg_hparams, not part of AdaTime's alg sweep).
No learning-rate scheduler. AdaTime builds StepLR(step_size 50, gamma 0.5), which never steps within 40 epochs.
DSAN: the range AdaTime gives for mmd_wt is applied to domain_loss_wt, the weight the DSAN loss reads.

Combination 0 is the Stage-2 setting: AdaTime's loss weights with learning rate 3e-4 (the learning rate of the supplied source-only training) instead of AdaTime's 5e-4 (Deep CORAL) or 1e-3 (DANN, DSAN). Stage 2 ran with 3e-4. Combination 1 is AdaTime hparams.py including its learning rate.
Random draws use numpy instead of wandb; as in wandb's random search, every parameter is drawn independently (values: uniform over the list; uniform: U(min, max)).
SRC is computed on source val (AdaTime: source test, trainers/abstract_trainer.py:246), so that source test stays untouched by any selection.

FST uses 5 windows per class from target val (AdaTime: from target test, trainers/abstract_trainer.py:147), drawn once with a fixed seed and the same for every run; target test is never used for a selection.
One seed (52) and one setting for all six transfers, as AdaTime uses one setting for all scenarios of a dataset.

few_shot.note: uses target labels (few-shot); the same windows for every run with this target

dev.domain_data: 96-dim eval-mode features: source train (label 1) vs target train (label 0)
dev.validation: source val; errors = cross-entropy per window
dev.raw_quantities: outputs.npz of every run: source_val_ce and dev_weights per source-val window
